verdict.rationale: UCP (the protocol Shopify implements) is described as industry-governed and openly published: "built by the industry" with a public co-developer list and "The complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations are hosted in our public GitHub repository," and profile docs reference an explicit "protocol version" field, indicating versioning. No evidence anywhere requires signing an agreement just to read or implement the spec. Missing for 10: explicit license terms for the spec, a concrete version-number scheme/changelog, and independent (non-Shopify) confirmation of frictionless read/implement access.
